events.title: English colonists destroy the Pequot fort at Mystic
events.description: Connecticut forces and their Mohegan and Narragansett allies set fire to the fortified village, killing some 400 to 700 Pequot, many of them women and children. The Pequot War ended months later.
events.html: Connecticut forces and their Mohegan and Narragansett allies set fire to the fortified village, killing some 400 to 700 Pequot, many of them women and children. The Pequot War ended months later.

events.title: Last public hanging takes place in England
events.description: Michael Barrett, convicted of the Clerkenwell bombing, was hanged before a crowd outside Newgate Prison. Three days later a new Act moved executions inside prison walls.
events.html: Michael Barrett, convicted of the Clerkenwell bombing, was hanged before a crowd outside Newgate Prison. Three days later a new Act moved executions inside prison walls.

events.title: Nicholas II is crowned Tsar of Russia
events.description: Nicholas II and Alexandra were crowned in the Kremlin's Dormition Cathedral. Days later more than a thousand people died in a crush at the celebrations on Khodynka Field, a grim omen for the reign.
events.html: Nicholas II and Alexandra were crowned in the Kremlin's Dormition Cathedral. Days later more than a thousand people died in a crush at the celebrations on Khodynka Field, a grim omen for the reign.

events.title: Evacuation of Allied troops from Dunkirk begins
events.description: Operation Dynamo began. By 4 June more than 338,000 British and French soldiers had been carried to England by warships and hundreds of civilian 'little ships'.
events.html: Operation Dynamo began. By 4 June more than 338,000 British and French soldiers had been carried to England by warships and hundreds of civilian 'little ships'.

events.title: Apollo 10 splashes down after the Moon landing rehearsal
events.description: Apollo 10 returned safely after its lunar module descended to about 15 km above the Moon. The mission tested every step of a landing except the touchdown itself.
